title: Mussolini, Feb. 23, 1941: Part 2
topic: Mussolini's February 23, 1941 speech to the Blackshirts of Rome, Part 2 (English translation, radio-style, with dated archival photographs)
caption_extra: Part 2 of Mussolini's February 23, 1941 speech to the Blackshirts of Rome, as translated into English at the time (excerpts; Part 1 is the opening). Read by a synthetic voice with a vintage-radio effect, not Mussolini's. Music: Verdi, La forza del destino overture, Toscanini, 1944 (public domain). No freely licensed photos of this exact speech exist in the archives checked; these public-domain photos are from Feb.-Aug. 1941 and are dated on screen.

beats.narration: But developments in history, which sometimes are speeded up, cannot be halted any more than the fleeting moment of Faust could be halted. History takes one by the throat and forces a decision. This is not the first time this has occurred in the history of Italy! If we had been 100 per cent ready we would have entered the war in September, 1939, and not in June, 1940. During that brief period of time we faced and overcame exceptional difficulties.
beats.label: With Franco, Bordighera, Feb. 12, 1941

beats.narration: In reality the moment was timely because if it is true that one enemy was in the course of liquidation there remained the other, the bigger one, the most powerful enemy number one, against whom we are engaged, and against whom we will continue the struggle to the last drop of blood.
beats.label: Mussolini in the Chamber, June 10, 1941

beats.narration: We must recognize this. We had gray days. This happens in all wars, in all times. Think of the Punic Wars, when the Battle of Cannae threatened to crush Rome. But at Zama, Rome destroyed Carthage and wiped it out from geography and history forever. Our capacity to recuperate in moral and material fields is really formidable, and constitutes one of the peculiar characteristics of our race.
beats.label: The Chamber, June 10, 1941

beats.narration: That we shall have to fight hard is certain. That we shall have to fight long is also probable. But the final result will be an Axis victory.
beats.label: Hitler and Mussolini, Aug. 1941
